name: Seungju Ahn
abstract_title: Analyzing Several Quantum Error-Correction Codes for Biological Orch-OR Model
abstract: The Orchestrated Objective Reduction (Orch OR) theory, proposed by Roger Penrose and Stuart Hameroff, associates consciousness with quantum phenomena occurring at the level of tubulin and microtubules, which are protein structures within the brain's sub-neuronal architecture. Although direct experimental evidence validating this theory has not yet been observed, the properties of tubulin as an information unit, as they proposed, are being demonstrated in indirect forms through various experiment
notable: Possible author on surface code/Orch-OR paper (BioSystems, 2025)
